title: Eleven Years on a Bench
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：company　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 company 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my grandfather ① kept company with a man who said almost nothing, and he said the keeping was the whole of the friendship. The ② company, meaning the sitting and not the talking, lasted eleven years and stayed that way; company, he said, is the only thing between two men that is judged by how little is said in it.

Every ③ company on that bench had the same hour, and the ④ company at the end, meaning the one he kept for the bad weeks and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever noticed twice. Company, my grandmother said, is nine parts sitting and one part somebody willing to arrive; my grandfather said the arriving is the part that fills the hour.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the company was the whole of the letterhead, meaning the firm and not the bench. The ⑥ company, meaning the firm and not any of that, is the only thing on a letterhead that everybody reads and nobody questions; company, she said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a sitting and a firm. He said the firm is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ company had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the hour. The ⑧ company of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in August, was one bench and thirty years of arriving; company, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to sit still. She said the sitting still was never mentioned.

The ⑨ company I remember is the one at the end, which began in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ company, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being kept; every company, she said, is a friendship that has agreed to look like a bench. She said the friendship was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 陪伴（指那种陪伴本身，与那些交谈相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep company with sb 与某人交往、陪伴某人
D. n. 陪伴（指那条长凳上每一次）
E. n. 陪伴（指末尾那一次）
F. n. 公司；商号（指信头上的那家商号）
G. n. 公司（指登记簿里提到的那一家）
H. n. 情谊；陪伴之情（抽象总称）

items.q: kept company with a man who said almost nothing
The company, meaning the sitting and not the talking
the company was the whole of the letterhead
the company had become a line in a register
The company of the whole thing
A company, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: keep company with sb 意为“与某人交往、陪伴某人”，1957 年祖父与一个几乎不说话的人来往。
company 意为“陪伴”，指那种陪伴本身而不是那些交谈，它持续了十一年。
company 指那条长凳上每一次陪伴，每一次都是同样的时辰。
company 指末尾那一次（他留给那些难熬的日子的那一次），是唯一有人留意过两次的。
company 意为“公司、商号”，母亲说那家公司就是信头的全部，指的是那家商号而不是那条长凳。
company 为另一个义项，指那家商号而不是那种陪伴，是信头上人人都读、却无人质疑的东西。
company 意为“公司”，指登记簿里提到的那一家，到 1965 年这家公司成了登记簿里的一行。
company 意为“情谊、陪伴之情”，祖父八月写道，整件事的情谊是一条长凳三十年的赴约。
company 意为“陪伴、交往”，我记得的是末尾那一次，1971 年开始，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
company 为抽象总称，祖母说一份陪伴是唯一会因为被维系而变好的东西。
